credentials.description: license key, sent as Authorization: Basic <license key> (the key as is, not base64 of user:password)
website ID of your LengoPay account, sent with the request (body field websiteid, or path segment for get_balance), separate from the license key

example_prompt: Add server-side LengoPay payment verification to my order fulfillment flow.

websiteid.description: Unique site identifier (Site ID in the LengoPay dashboard).

status.description: Final transaction status. Always in UPPERCASE.

gotchas: Always call verify_payment server-side before confirming an order. The webhook alone is not enough — it can be forged by anyone who knows your callback_url.
PENDING is a valid status: the payment is being processed. Do not fulfill the order on PENDING — wait for SUCCESS.
The status is strictly UPPERCASE: compare with status === 'SUCCESS'.
The endpoint changed in v1.2.0: it is now POST /api/v1/transaction/status with pay_id and websiteid in the body. The old GET /api/v1/payments/{payId} no longer works.
